capabilities: rss-aggregation | Subscribes to RSS and Atom feeds, refreshes them on a schedule and lets you read, search and organize the articles in a web interface.
feed-reader-api | Serves the Google Reader compatible and Fever APIs so mobile and desktop feed-reader apps can sync with the instance using its API password.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official FreshRSS image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. FreshRSS is a self-hosted RSS and Atom feed aggregator: subscribe to feeds, organize them in categories, read, star and search articles, and import or export your subscriptions as OPML. A built-in job refreshes every feed twice an hour. The Google Reader compatible and Fever APIs are switched on, so feed-reader apps can sync with the instance. Everything is kept in the instance's own SQLite database, stored in the `freshrss` folder of your home, so it survives stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated passwords. Sign in at `https://<instance>/` with the administrator name and password, and add your feeds. The separate API password is the one feed-reader apps use. The three settings only take effect the first time FreshRSS starts on an empty data folder; afterwards the existing account is kept. You can run one FreshRSS instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream FreshRSS documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

FRESHRSS_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own. It is the account's password only when FreshRSS first creates it on an empty data folder; if the account already exists this value is ignored and the existing password still applies. Change the password in FreshRSS's own settings. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.

FRESHRSS_ADMIN_USER.description: The administrator's user name, created on the first start. It is used only when FreshRSS first runs on an empty data folder; if the data already exists (an earlier enrollment, or a later restart) this value is ignored and the existing users still apply.
